InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: Input dataset with a velocity vector field.

IntVectorProperty.name: Criterion
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Selects whether to compute parallel vectors of velocity vs acceleration (VKA) or velocity vs jerk (VKB).

DoubleVectorProperty.name: HyperbolicityThreshold
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Only extract regions with saddle-like projected Jacobians: det(J⊥)/|v| < -threshold.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: AngleThreshold
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Maximum deviation angle (in degrees) between velocity and acceleration/jerk vectors.

Documentation.long_help: Extracts 3D bifurcation lines using parallel vector analysis and local hyperbolicity conditions. Based on Machado, Sadlo and Roth 2015.
